title: Sequoia
summary: A pipeline that builds a dataset of time snapshots from tabular client data (e.g., HR/chemistry attributes) and trains a neural-network classifier on it. Its experimental scripts use SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer to fit and sample synthetic tabular data and evaluate_quality to score it, with CTGAN/TVAE synthesizer imports left commented out.
needs: CTGANSynthesizer/TVAESynthesizer are imported in dataset.py/dataset_chemistry.py but only appear commented-out (unused); real domain of the tabular data (HR vs chemistry) is ambiguous from evidence.
